text: The Public Appointments Secretariat has prepared an overview of the 2025 Work Plan for the Corporations Nominating Panel.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Amended Attachment 1 to the report (November 27, 2024) from the City Clerk, by deleting CreateTO from the first quarter of 2025, and by moving Toronto Hydro from the third quarter of 2025 to the second quarter of 2025.
